title: Brain implant restores gestures, speech for some paralysis patients through virtual avatars
author: Catherine Stoddard
description: A brain-computer interface device may help paralyzed people talk and make gestures at the same time, according to a recent study.

title: Science Corp. names president as it looks to roll out vision-restoring implant
author: Conor Hale
description: Former chief strategy officer Darius Shahida will continue leading commercialization efforts as Science rolls out its Prima implant to Europe.
